/*selectCommonMpIvTranBuyerChoicePopList*/ SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER , B.COM_NAME_LOC , B.COM_NAME_ENG , B.ADDRESS_LOC , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND STATUS = 'C' AND PRIORITY = 'Y')) AS KEP_USER_NAME , (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND STATUS = 'C' AND PRIORITY = 'Y')) AS KEP_USER_PHONE , (SELECT EMAIL FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT KEP_USER_ID FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND STATUS = 'C' AND PRIORITY = 'Y')) AS KEP_USER_EMAIL FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMCMPY B, KEP_BUYER_FLAG C WHERE A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE(+)
AND B.COM_NAME_LOC like '%'||#{st_buyer_name}||'%'
AND C.INVOICE_PRINT_FLAG = 'Y'
AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY B.COM_NAME_LOC

/*selectCommonMpIvBpTranBuyerChoicePopList*/ SELECT DISTINCT B.COM_CODE BUYER , B.COM_NAME_LOC , B.COM_NAME_ENG , B.ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY B, KEP_BUYER_FLAG C WHERE B.COM_CODE = C.COM_CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
AND B.COM_NAME_LOC like '%'||#{st_buyer_name}||'%'
AND C.INVOICE_PRINT_FLAG = 'Y'
ORDER BY B.COM_NAME_LOC
